[type]
Lexer

[grammar]
lexer grammar M;

@lexer::members {

def canEndRawString(self):
    start = self._tokenStartCharIndex
    txt = self._input.getText(start + 1, self._input.index - 2)
    parts = txt.split('|')
    return parts[0] == parts[-1]

}
